title: MAT Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Material operators, noting that MAT has no operator-specific members or methods and uses the inherited OP Class surface for lookup, parameters, tags, storage, diagnostics, and common OP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when generated Python needs to manipulate MAT operators through common OP behavior rather than MAT-specific methods.
For MAT scripting, use inherited OP features such as op()/opex lookup, par/parGroup parameter access, tags, storage, and diagnostics.
Do not invent MAT-specific Python methods; current official MAT Class docs state there are no operator-specific members or methods.
For shader-material behavior, pair this class reference with Write a GLSL MAT and individual MAT operator cards.
